svg.title: OSDApps: from WinPE to apps and scripts before first sign-in
svg.desc: Optionally prepare a USB cache in full Windows. In WinPE, independent built-in and repository sources plus available cached content feed one staged queue. At first boot, SetupComplete prepares built-in content and executes apps and scripts once in order. Results remain available as Windows setup continues to OOBE.
svg.text: Stage in WinPE. Run before the first sign-in.
Built-in apps and your own packages, in one ordered deployment.
Optional preparation on a Windows PC: save the module and pre-cache content on USB.
1 WinPE · after OSDCloud applies Windows
Built-in apps
Stage vendor app configuration
Your repository
Stage apps and script packages
Optional USB cache
Reuse available matching content
One ordered queue · local content · standalone runtime
2 First Windows boot · SetupComplete runs once
PreInstall · prepare built-ins
Refresh from vendors or use valid cached content.
Validate replacements before switching the cache.
Prepare local payloads for the runner.
Runner · execute the queue
Install apps and run scripts as SYSTEM.
Use the staged order and record each outcome.
No automatic retry after reboot.
3 Results retained · Windows setup continues to OOBE / Autopilot
Clean staging on success. Retain staging on failure. Keep the persistent result and log.
OOBE is not a success check: review the recorded package outcomes.
